items.question: List the patient numbers of everyone with type 2 diabetes.
items.reference:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT ?pid WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?dx a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?c . ?c a icd-10-gm:E11 . } BIND(SUBSTR(STR(?g), 39) AS ?pid) } GROUP BY ?pid

items.question: What is the latest record date for type 2 diabetes diagnoses?
items.reference:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>

PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>

SELECT (MAX(?d) AS ?latest) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?dx a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?c . ?c a icd-10-gm:E11 . ?dx sphn:hasRecordDateTime ?d . } } GROUP BY ?dx
